targets.rawSql: SELECT battery_level as "SOC [%]" FROM charges c join charging_processes p ON p.id = c.charging_process_id WHERE $__timeFilter(date) AND p.car_id = $car_id ORDER BY c.ID DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT battery_level * $BatteryCapacity / 100 as "kWh", $BatteryCapacity AS Total FROM charges c join charging_processes p ON p.id = c.charging_process_id WHERE $__timeFilter(date) AND p.car_id = $car_id ORDER BY c.ID DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT $BatteryCapacity AS "Battery Capacity"

panels.description:
请在充电过程中打开这个仪表板。打开后默认显示最近 15 分钟的数据，你需要点击右上角的"当前充电"按钮进入展示（Kiosk）模式：

- 如果正在充电，会显示本次充电从开始到现在的数据，并每 30 秒自动刷新一次。

- 如果没有在充电，会显示上一次充电的数据。

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(date,$__interval), avg(charge_energy_added) as "Added" FROM charges WHERE charging_process_id = $charging_processes AND $__timeFilter(date) GROUP BY 1

SELECT COALESCE(g.name, CONCAT_WS(', ', COALESCE(addresses.name, CONCAT_WS(' ', addresses.road, addresses.house_number)), addresses.city)) FROM 	charging_processes c 	LEFT JOIN addresses ON addresses.id = c.address_id 	LEFT JOIN geofences g ON g.id = geofence_id WHERE 	c.id = $charging_processes

SELECT $__time(date), battery_level as "SOC [%]", (case when charger_phases >= 1 then (case when charger_phases = 2 then 3 when charger_phases = 1 then 1 else 0 end) * charger_actual_current * charger_voltage / 1000.0 else charger_power end) as "Power [kW]", (case when battery_heater_on then 10 when battery_heater then 10 else 0 end) as "Battery heater" FROM charges c JOIN charging_processes p ON p.id = c.charging_process_id WHERE $__timeFilter(date) and p.car_id = $car_id ORDER BY 1
SELECT battery_level as "Initial SOC" FROM charges 	where charging_process_id=$charging_processes 	ORDER BY DATE ASC 	LIMIT 1

SELECT battery_level - (SELECT battery_level as "Added" FROM charges where charging_process_id=$charging_processes	ORDER BY DATE ASC 	LIMIT 1) as "Added" FROM charges c join charging_processes p ON p.id = c.charging_process_id WHERE $__timeFilter(date) AND p.car_id = $car_id ORDER BY c.ID DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (end_date - start_date)) AS "Elapsed" FROM 
  (SELECT min(date) as start_date FROM charges where charging_process_id=$charging_processes) s
  CROSS JOIN 
  (SELECT max(date) as end_date FROM charges where charging_process_id=$charging_processes) e

WITH converted_positions AS (
	SELECT
		$__timeGroup(date, '5s') AS time,
		(wgs84_to_gcj02(latitude, longitude)).gcjLat AS gcj_latitude,
		(wgs84_to_gcj02(latitude, longitude)).gcjLon AS gcj_longitude
	FROM
		positions
	WHERE
		car_id = $car_id AND
		$__timeFilter(date)
)
SELECT
	time,
	avg(gcj_latitude) AS latitude,
	avg(gcj_longitude) AS longitude
FROM
	converted_positions
GROUP BY
	time
ORDER BY
	time ASC;

SELECT ROUND(convert_km(max(end_km)::numeric, '$length_unit'),0) || ' $length_unit' as odometer
FROM drives WHERE car_id =  $car_id;

panels.description: 车载充电机报告的交流输入电流。直流快充时该字段不提供电池组电流，因此不显示数值。

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(date,$__interval), avg(CASE WHEN charger_power > 0 AND charger_phases >= 1 AND charger_actual_current > 0 THEN charger_actual_current END) AS "AC Input Current" FROM charges WHERE charging_process_id = $charging_processes AND $__timeFilter(date) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.description: 车载充电机报告的交流输入电压。直流快充时该字段不提供电池组电压，因此不显示数值。

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(date,$__interval), avg(CASE WHEN charger_power > 0 AND charger_phases >= 1 AND charger_voltage > 2 THEN charger_voltage END) AS "AC Input Voltage" FROM charges WHERE charging_process_id = $charging_processes AND $__timeFilter(date) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(date,$__interval), avg(case when charger_phases >= 1 then (case when charger_phases = 2 then 3 when charger_phases = 1 then 1 else 0 end) * charger_actual_current * charger_voltage / 1000.0 else charger_power end) as "Power" FROM charges WHERE charging_process_id = $charging_processes AND $__timeFilter(date) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT MIN(convert_km(${preferred_range}_battery_range_km, '$length_unit')) as start_$length_unit
FROM charges WHERE charging_process_id = $charging_processes

SELECT ROUND(convert_km(end_range - start_range, '$length_unit'),0) as added_$length_unit 
FROM
(SELECT MIN(${preferred_range}_battery_range_km) as start_range
FROM charges WHERE charging_process_id = $charging_processes) s
CROSS JOIN (
SELECT MAX(${preferred_range}_battery_range_km) as  end_range 
FROM charges WHERE charging_process_id = $charging_processes) e

SELECT MAX(convert_km(${preferred_range}_battery_range_km, '$length_unit')) as  current_$length_unit 
FROM charges WHERE charging_process_id = $charging_processes

SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(date,$__interval), avg(convert_celsius(outside_temp, '$temp_unit')) as outdoor_$temp_unit FROM charges WHERE charging_process_id = $charging_processes AND $__timeFilter(date) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(date,$__interval), avg(convert_celsius(inside_temp, '$temp_unit')) AS inside_$temp_unit FROM positions WHERE car_id = $car_id and inside_temp is not null AND $__timeFilter(date) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT 	$__timeGroupAlias(date,$__interval), 	avg(convert_celsius(driver_temp_setting, '$temp_unit')) as driver_$temp_unit FROM positions WHERE driver_temp_setting IS NOT NULL AND car_id = $car_id AND $__timeFilter(date) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

list.name: BatteryCapacity
list.query:
WITH Aux AS
(SELECT car_id,
		COALESCE(efficiency, 
		(SELECT efficiency
			FROM cars WHERE id = $car_id) * 100) AS efficiency
	FROM (
		SELECT ROUND((charge_energy_added / NULLIF(end_rated_range_km - start_rated_range_km, 0))::numeric, 3) * 100 as efficiency,
			COUNT(*) as count, $car_id AS car_id 
		FROM charging_processes
		WHERE car_id = $car_id
			AND duration_min > 10
			AND end_battery_level <= 95
			AND start_rated_range_km IS NOT NULL
			AND end_rated_range_km IS NOT NULL
			AND charge_energy_added > 0
		GROUP BY 1
		ORDER BY 2 DESC
		LIMIT 1
	) AS DerivatedEfficiency
),
CurrentCapacity	 AS
(SELECT AVG(Capacity) AS CurrentCapacity 
FROM (
SELECT 
	c.${preferred_range}_battery_range_km * aux.efficiency / c.usable_battery_level AS Capacity 
	FROM charging_processes cp
		INNER JOIN charges c
		ON c.charging_process_id = cp.id 
                INNER JOIN aux ON cp.car_id = aux.car_id
	WHERE cp.car_id = $car_id
		AND cp.end_date IS NOT NULL
		AND cp.charge_energy_added >= aux.efficiency
		AND c.usable_battery_level > 0
	 ORDER BY cp.end_date DESC, c.date DESC LIMIT 100) AS lastCharges
)
SELECT CurrentCapacity FROM CurrentCapacity
